title: Just get to halftime
summary: A Seattle rushing play near its own goal line became a San Francisco fumble-recovery touchdown just before halftime. The Seahawks lost 32–29.

timeline.label: Late second quarter
timeline.text: San Francisco punted Seattle deep into its own territory.

timeline.label: Before the break
timeline.text: George Holani lost the ball; Gracen Halton recovered in the end zone.

timeline.label: Halftime
timeline.text: San Francisco led 21–13. Seattle had given up three first-half touchdowns after turnovers.

unusual: A possession intended to reach halftime safely produced an immediate defensive score instead.
explanations: Ball security and field position explain the danger. A kneel also needs space behind the line; assuming it was risk-free would oversimplify the situation.
questions: Accounts differ on the exact starting spot. The team play-by-play records the touchdown possession from SEA 4.
